environment.clock: common wall-time start mapped once onto per-process monotonic clocks; RTT uses same sender clock

plan.blocked_collection: Exact DiagnosticCollectionIncomplete failure, writer pipe_write observed per role, stop within 5 s, full delivery; never SC-010 success.
plan.delivery: Every active flow must deliver exactly the declared offered messages with zero loss/corruption/generator errors. No delivery noise allowance.
plan.noise_method: twice pre-change reference repeat spread or declared resolution floor; fixed before candidate construction and measurements
plan.normal_collection: No event/status/coverage loss or numeric overflow; qlog must remain active within published caps.
plan.pair_order: Adjacent baseline/candidate, alternating first role by pair index; every run and paired delta must pass. Re-measured baseline must remain within frozen reference variability.
plan.rationale: The mandatory telemetry allowance is an absolute 0.02 of one CPU core per role at 100 pps, retaining 0.98 core of the single reactor for other work; optional filtered tracing is explicitly allowed 0.05 core. These are workload-specific cost budgets, not universal percentages. RSS budgets cover the bounded 2 MiB diagnostic storage and, for active qlog, an additional 1 MiB allocator/native tracing margin. Added p95 RTT is limited to 0.5 ms, one tenth of the separate release added-RTT ceiling. Clock-tick, 256 KiB RSS and 0.25 ms timing floors account for measurement granularity. No release criterion is waived.
plan.scope: New Phase 7 acceptance cycle against exact Phase 6; prior missed freeze remains historical. One-session low-rate native loopback only.
